== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Stalker (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Stalker (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]] (by 7 April 2016). The disc card (lower part, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>5c31a9028530d27a805161ade1adcda2a3491e73</code>.

Fair use rationale: crops of copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card images, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee), used only to show the differences between versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
